theorem allSitesCaller (p : Program) (t : RMBisim.Tree)
    (ht : RMBisim.ptree p = t) (hs : SiteCoverage.allSites SitePerm252.checkSite [] t = true)
    (logical : Configuration) (binary : Config 252)
    (hc : Clean p logical.path)
    (gap : Nat) (spares : List Nat)
    (hf : DispatchFrame SitePerm252.dispatch binary logical gap spares) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p logical ↔ BinaryHalts machinePerm252 binary :=
  allSites_halts_iff_binary p t ht hs logical binary ⟨hc, gap, spares, hf⟩

theorem zeroBootRelated (p : Program) :
    Related p zeroRoot (machinePerm252.run 82552) := by
  refine ⟨RegisterPathClean.clean_nil p, 40, BootPerm252.bootSparesPerm252, ?_⟩
  simpa only [SitePerm252.dispatch, BootstrapFramePerm252.dispatchPerm252] using
    BootstrapFramePerm252.boot_dispatch_frame

theorem zeroBootCaller (p : Program) (hc : Covered p) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p zeroRoot ↔ BinaryHalts machinePerm252 (machinePerm252.run 82552) :=
  register_halts_iff_binary p hc zeroRoot _ (zeroBootRelated p)

theorem blank_prefix (M : Machine n) (N : Nat) :
    BinaryHalts M (M.run N) ↔ ∃ t, (M.run t).state = none := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨N + t, by simpa only [Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom] using ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    have he : M.run (N + t) = M.run (t + N) := by rw [Nat.add_comm N t]
    have hh := M.runFrom_of_halted (M.run t) ht N
    rw [Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom, Machine.run_add_eq_runFrom, hh] at he
    rw [he]
    exact ht

theorem zeroBlankCaller (p : Program) (hc : Covered p) :
    RegisterPath.Halts p zeroRoot ↔ ∃ t, (machinePerm252.run t).state = none :=
  (zeroBootCaller p hc).trans (blank_prefix machinePerm252 82552)
